title: City of Laredo Schedules District 7 Brush and Bulky Item Collection for Dec. 4
excerpt: The City of Laredo's Fall Brush & Bulky Item Collection will serve District 7 on Friday, Dec. 4, 2026. Residents should place eligible items curbside before 6:00 a.m. Collection is for active residential accounts only.
content:
The City of Laredo is giving District 7 residents a chance to clean up before the holidays. The Fall Brush & Bulky Item Collection will serve District 7 on Friday, Dec. 4, 2026.

Residents can set out old furniture, appliances, mattresses and brush. Items must be placed curbside before 6:00 a.m. on collection day, without blocking streets or sidewalks.

Collection is available to active residential accounts only. Residents who are not sure which council district they live in can look it up by address on the city's online map.

For more information, call (956) 796-1098 or 3-1-1.

Sources: City of Laredo, Nov. 25, 2026.
